Export incident data to PDF.
Microsoft Defender automatically assigns a name based on alert attributes such as the
number of endpoints affected, users affected, detection sources or categories. The
incident name allows you to quickly understand the scope of the incident. For example:
Multi-stage incident on multiple endpoints reported by multiple sources.
To edit the incident name, take the following steps:
1. Follow the instructions in the opening section to Access the Manage incident pane.
2. Type a new name in the Incident name field on the Manage incident pane.
3. Select Save.
When doing a postmortem of an incident, view the incident's Activity log to see the
history of actions performed on the incident (called "Audits") and any comments
recorded. All changes made to the incident, whether by a user or by the system, are
recorded in the activity log.
1. Open the incident's activity log. From the incident page, or from the incident
details panel on the incident queue page, select the three dots in the upper right
corner, and from the resulting menu, select Activity log.
